answer.text: The front and rear brake pads must be checked for wear at the intervals in the periodic maintenance chart.
The manual says the pads need to be replaced if a brake pad is "warm to the indicator."

disclaimers.text: The manual sections supplied give no mileage, time or pad thickness for replacement.
The replacement wording is unclear, so confirm when the pads need replacing with an authorised Royal Enfield service centre.
